result: Original GPU construction parameters restored. The sparse 384-D speedup is withdrawn; a fresh fixed-parameter 384-D comparison is pending server access.

high_dimensional_query_fix.note: Historical dense-graph query-frontier regression; recall for the current sparse build profile is reported in the accepted 384-D benchmark.

excluded_benchmark.reason: Historical m=32 CPU profile failed the 95% quality gate and remains excluded. CPU m=64 calibration reached 97.6%/97.7%, but the fixed-parameter GPU comparison has not been rerun.

validation_method.metric: squared L2; float32 normalized random vectors
validation_method.speedup: median VSAG DDL seconds / median cuvs DDL seconds
validation_method.order: alternating backend order across three trials
validation_method.data_load: excluded; all rows present before DDL
validation_method.first_ready: DDL plus first SQL ANN query, reported separately
validation_method.algorithm_note: VSAG HNSW versus hipVS CAGRA in seekdb HNSW SQL route; graph parameters differ
validation_method.initial_trials: Default-session and insufficient-quality CPU calibration trials are retained but excluded from accepted speedups.
validation_method.historical_query_fix_scope: Only query-frontier selection changed: dimensions >256 retain 1024 candidates and use MULTI_CTA. Index construction and the 128-D configuration are unchanged.
validation_method.current_build_profile: Original parameters are frozen: graph_degree=128, intermediate_graph_degree=256 (n-1 at the 256-row boundary), nn_descent_niter=100. Search frontiers are restored to the pre-sparse 512/1024 values.

measurement_provenance: Accepted 128-D measurements use the original 128/256-edge, 100-iteration GPU profile. The 32/64-edge, 6-iteration 384-D experiment is historical and withdrawn from accepted performance claims. No 384-D fixed-parameter speedup is currently asserted.
limitations: Single gfx1100 GPU and synthetic normalized float32 L2 data.
VSAG HNSW is compared with CAGRA in the seekdb HNSW SQL route; this is not conversion to a VSAG HNSW graph.
No multi-GPU, long-duration or heavy-concurrency validation was performed.
No separate compiler was observed in the process samples.
The sparse-profile 69.63x claim is withdrawn; fixed-parameter 384-D retesting is pending remote access.

current_gpu_build_profile.small_input_constraint: intermediate degree is capped at n-1 for the 256-row boundary

withdrawn_benchmark.reason: The 32/64-edge, 6-iteration experiment changed the supplied construction parameters. Its 69.63x result is withdrawn from accepted contest/fixed-parameter performance claims.
